title: Zelensky confirms Ukraine targeted Russian emergency alert systems in retaliatory hack
summary: Late on Nov. 1, Ukraine's Air Alert app, which provides vital updates to citizens about incoming Russian strikes, was hacked. Hours after the false warnings were sent to Ukrainian citizens' phones, Russia's own air raid alert system began to show signs of being compromised.

title: As Moldova races ahead of Ukraine on reforms, EU set to reveal verdict on Kyiv's progress
summary: The EU’s Nov. 4 Enlargement Package will grade Ukraine’s accession progress and will likely show how far Moldova has outpaced Kyiv on reforms.

title: Poland deploys counterterrorism police near Russian border amid sabotage warnings
summary: According to RMF FM, Polish military intelligence and allied intelligence services warned last week that acts of sabotage could occur near the Russian border, potentially including incursions by armed groups.

title: Russian missile attack hits Kharkiv medical facility, 62 reported injured
summary: Terekhov said approximately 200 patients would be evacuated to other medical facilities as emergency services worked at the scene.

title: Russian oil refinery in Yaroslavl reportedly struck, multiple fires reported
summary: Ukraine has repeatedly targeted the facility, including most recently, a Sept. 17 strike that damaged its AVT-3 crude oil processing unit, according to Ukraine's General Staff.

title: Putin orders Russian data centers to reserve capacity to assist state IT infrastructure
summary: With the decree, a newly established government commission will have the authority to claim reserved capacity, which must be made accessible within 24 hours of the government's notification.

title: Witkoff reveals location, date for new trilateral peace deal negotiations
summary: U.S. Special Envoy Steve Witkoff announced on Nov. 3 that new rounds of trilateral peace negotiations between Russia, Ukraine, and the U.S. will be held on Nov. 10 in Abu Dhabi.
